method: Isolated Playwright CLI browser; observed UI controls and snapshots; safe navigation, filtering and explicit public synthetic-demo access only. No Jev queue used.
scope: 15 assigned public projects; one bounded useful flow where publicly accessible, or the actual access/hosting boundary. Not every advertised feature, independent numerical validation or an organiser roster.
coverageNotes: HomeLoop navigation was exercised at 1440px; its 390px capture is layout evidence only.
The remaining interactive flows were exercised at 390px, followed by desktop and mobile captures of the resulting state. Desktop captures do not establish replay of each flow at both widths.

No accounts were created, messages sent, reports posted, payments made, investments purchased, availability changed, or records updated. Green Loop's explicitly offered synthetic resident demo was used for read-only portfolio access.
No microphone, camera or GPS permission was granted. MOVA displayed a microphone-denied notice after selecting the visual-impairment profile.
Document overflow observations refer to the outer document, not every internal scroll container or cross-origin iframe.
Screenshots follow viewport changes; partially loaded or recentered map tiles and lazy images are not treated as established product defects.
Alternate CasCas, JiranLink GitHub Pages and Teduh sdp-app.html pages were covered by the original visual ledger but were not repeated in this supplemental functional pass.
Givlah's external video was not played in this pass. The written documentation chapter was navigated; its screenshots are not live application interactions.

projects.name: HomeLoop
actions: Clicked Value my home for free.
observed: Navigated to /login?next=/valuation.
Sign in heading, email/password fields and account tabs rendered.

projects.name: Givlah
observed: URL hash became #step-match.
Find a compatible crew heading and the matching-step explanation were visible.
The page explicitly says Hosted demo: not available yet.
untested: Live listing, offer, matching, invitation and confirmation
projects.visualNotes: Readable cream/forest chapter cards. Mobile capture shows the Step 03 source screenshot; this remains an image inside documentation. Desktop retained a later scroll position after resize, with some lazy images blank at capture; no product failure is inferred.

projects.name: WasteLoop

Public demo-account notes were visible; authentication was not attempted.

The app labels chargers as demo data and this-device state.

projects.name: SD-Wallet

Demo mode says no login and data stays on this device.

projects.name: MOVA

The Visually Impaired profile became visibly selected.
Map markers, a reported ramp and a route-warning panel rendered.
A microphone-denied notice appeared; permission was not granted.

projects.name: Township Green Loop

Portfolio rendered active investment, payout, profit and principal totals.
Allocation chart, payout-over-time chart and payout history rendered.

projects.name: Teduh

Built 1 reduced the table to one data row, two including its header.
The remaining built report is R-1035 for Lingkaran Taman.

projects.name: NgamSoil

Six linked intake entries rendered.

projects.name: SIAGA
observed: HTTP 404.
The page says This page doesn’t exist and DEPLOYMENT_NOT_FOUND.
untested: Every product feature; no SIAGA application screen was available at this URL

projects.name: MapOKU
observed: The response is JSON with service mapoku-backend and status ok, plus documentation and health paths.
No resident app navigation appeared at that URL.
untested: API correctness beyond the displayed response
projects.visualNotes: Both captures show the browser JSON viewer. Backend health is not proof of the resident application workflow.

projects.name: AccessTwin
actions: Allowed the initial Streamlit host/loading state to settle; the actual Network screen then appeared.
observed: Network rendered a fictional Elmina-style demo township and synthetic-data labels.
Compare rendered a baseline/scenario map, score table and assumptions.
The Scenario radio became checked.
After rerender, displayed wheelchair journey changed from Available journey 1.1 km to Simulated journey 450 m.
The page explicitly says nothing changes the recorded network.
automationNotes: The first attempt to check the styled hidden radio input timed out; clicking its observed visible text succeeded. The timeout is not classified as a product failure.
projects.visualNotes: Restrained cream/editorial comparison with explicit synthetic/simulated labels and tabular provenance. Mobile places the explanation and score above the map controls. Earlier hosting-only observations are superseded for reachability by this settled-load check.
